chunks: And the certain promise (of Doom) comes near. Then the eyes of unbelievers will be fixed in horror, (and they will cry:) "Ah, woe betide, we were indeed heedless of this, and were oppressors and unjust."
ai.seo_question: What do the disbelievers say when the Day of Judgment arrives?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the suddenness of divine reckoning, where the 'fixed eyes' signify the paralysis of those who ignored the Ahl al-Bayt's guidance. The lament 'we were wrongdoers' (zalimin) underscores self-inflicted spiritual ruin rather than mere ignorance, a theme central to the concept of *taqdir* (divine decree) meeting human *ikhtiyar* (free will).
